history.description: per lease history key: durations of earlier holds in milliseconds, oldest first

Summary.description: The default view of `repo fleet status`, derived from the detail report alone: totals per window, per-origin counters only where anomalous, findings grouped by id with counts and subjects, workers that need a look as rows and the healthy ones as one list. Everything else is behind `--detail`, `--origin` and `--section`.

Selection.description: The sections of the detail report that `--section` and `--origin` selected, each exactly as in the full report; with `--origin` the workers, machines, counters and findings are those of that origin.

FleetFact.description: The machines of the fleet as the scheduler of remote execution sees them, with the counters of the cache server.

KeyComparison.description: The key inputs of recent unit misses compared across origins (digests only): how many origins published a sample, how many units at least two of them sampled, the units whose key components differ (crate, slot, origins, differing component names, whether the source was the same everywhere) and how many units each component differs in.

hostName.description: The state of the operating system host name of the machine as its published address set says: `ok`, `duplicate` (another origin carries the same label, named in `others`), `named-as` (the machine carries the semantic name of another origin, named in `others`) or `unknown` (no published set or no usable label). Never an identity; the way out is `repo fleet hostname apply` on that machine.

WorkerMemory.description: What one worker's host warden published to the group store as memory.json, read without the scheduler: the host numbers, the level and mode, the interventions so far and the last alarm with its own EN and DE text. An absent record (the warden writes no fresh state) has every number null.

MemoryFact.description: The memory records of the workers by origin (null: no readable record) and the one of the local warden, none of them read from the scheduler.

hostName.description: The state of the operating system host name of the machine as its published address set says: `ok`, `duplicate` (another origin carries the same label, named in `others`), `named-as` (the machine carries the semantic name of another origin, named in `others`) or `unknown` (no published set or no usable label). Never an identity; the way out is `repo fleet hostname apply` on that machine.

WorkersFact.description: The workers of the fleet as their readiness records and the heartbeats of their machines say, judged by the age rule of the readiness schema: a record alone never proves a worker lives.

CasFact.description: The host content store as the cache server's collector sees it: the cap in force, its watermarks, the leases of transient offload inputs (count and bytes; bytes are null above the stat bound) and the last finished collection (its time and the bytes it left); nothing is walked.

RetentionFact.description: What the last staleness sweep of the fleet cache found, as its status endpoint reports it (the StalenessReport of the slot schema).

RetentionSection.description: Retention of the fleet cache: its mode, the age of the last sweep (null when it never swept), entries judged (declared), stale (with the reasons), unreachable and undeclared, and what the publish gate refused.

RatesFact.description: What the cumulative counters of every machine added up to inside each trailing window, read from the multi-resolution metric rings the machines publish (a machine without rings has no entry); a counter that only ever adds up shows history, a window shows what goes on.

OffloadFact.description: Units of this machine's builds that run in compile slots (local) and in light slots (on the fleet), per build (the parent process of the slot holders), and the offload counters with the count of every decline or fall-back reason.

spool.description: The jobs of the machine's unit cache root waiting in the upload spool for the fleet cache, and the bound beyond which a compile waits for room.
